description_en: Transfers a call to a skill group by using a single-step or two-step transfer
description_zh: 调用TransferCallToSkillGroup接口执行单/双步转交到技能组
name: TransferCallToSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotency verification and can be generated by using a UUID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AICCS instance. You can obtain the instance ID in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account, which is the mobile phone number or email address specified during account registration. The name must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the hotline session
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The job ID in the WebSocket connection after an inbound call
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The connection ID in the WebSocket connection after an inbound call
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en: The hold connection ID in the WebSocket connection after an inbound call. This parameter is required only for a two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh: 呼入后，websocket中的holdConnId（仅在双步转时传入）
parameters.name: hold_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The transfer type. Default value: 1. Valid values:
1: single-step transfer.
2: two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh:
默认值为1。取值：
1：单步转。
2：双步转
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a single-step transfer. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: single-step transfer.
false: two-step transfer
parameters.help_zh:
默认值为true，取值：
true：单步转。
false：双步转
parameters.name: is_single_transfer

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
